title: Red Hat Security Advisory: kernel security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: This Red Hat security advisory addresses multiple vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel packages for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8. The update fixes several security issues including use-after-free (UAF) and out-of-bounds (OOB) errors in kernel components such as SCTP, SMC, RDMA, and Open vSwitch. The advisory emphasizes the importance of applying the update and rebooting the system to mitigate these vulnerabilities.
